qualification: Independent mode/stage bars and complete row fills qualify groups. Boundary paint and expected separator states are checked afterward.
limits: This repeats the maintained default Paper and forwarded Box adjacency fixture after source-class, slot and closure changes. It does not exercise every slot API or custom root on a device.
Source opacity is intentionally overridden to expose display suppression.
Qualified recorded groups do not establish every display frame, exact animation-start timing, conditional inherited text timing, Android paint, broader accessibility or release performance.
The separate Node/React lifetime controls isolate library ownership with controlled animation host wrappers; native heap behavior is not measured here.
Unknown Text, SVG and noncooperating custom peers retain the documented limitations.
